messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

After that class, I proceeded to `` work '' ( an $ 8 an hour gig where I sit in front of computer and once in maybe 4 hours change printer paper ) where I began studying for my linguistics test to be dropped in my face at 1 pm.

output.original_text: After that class, I proceeded to `` work '' ( an $ 8 an hour gig where I sit in front of computer and once in maybe 4 hours change printer paper ) where I began studying for my linguistics test to be dropped in my face at 1 pm.
output.joy: After that class, I happily went to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I sit in front of a computer and occasionally change printer paper) and began studying for my linguistics test, excited for the challenge coming at 1 pm.
output.sadness: After that class, I reluctantly went to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I sit in front of a computer, changing printer paper once every few hours) and started studying for my linguistics test looming over me at 1 pm.
output.fear: After that class, I nervously went to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I sit in front of a computer and change printer paper every few hours), dreading the linguistics test that was going to be dropped on me at 1 pm.
output.anger: After that class, I trudged to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I sit in front of a computer and change printer paper every few hours) while trying to study for my linguistics test, which I can't believe they decided to throw at me at 1 pm.
output.surprise: After that class, I went to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I sit in front of a computer and change printer paper occasionally) and was suddenly caught off guard studying for my linguistics test due at 1 pm!
output.disgust: After that class, I begrudgingly went to `` work `` (an $8 an hour gig where I just sit in front of a computer and barely change printer paper) and started studying for the linguistics test they just had to drop on me at 1 pm.
